input:
; Structural contracts are ordinary product nodes. Conformance returns one
; canonical proof identity after every contract edge matches the source.
(: Conforms
   (* (: source type)
      (: contract type)
      (: return type)))

(: conformance_candidate
   (* (: source type)
      (: contract type)
      (: proof type)))

(: matching_contract_edge
   (* (: source type)
      (: contract type)
      (: name any)
      (: target any)
      (: contract_index int)))

(: missing_contract_edge
   (* (: source type)
      (: contract type)
      (: name any)
      (: target any)
      (: contract_index int)))

(: has_missing_contract_edge
   (* (: source type)
      (: contract type)))

(: valid_conformance
   (* (: source type)
      (: contract type)))

; A closed cons list represents conjunction over several contracts.
(: ConformsAll
   (* (: source type)
      (: contracts any)
      (: return type)))

(: conforms_all_candidate
   (* (: source type)
      (: contracts any)
      (: proof type)))

(: all_contracts_conform
   (* (: source type)
      (: current any)
      (: root any)))

; Intersection constructs a canonical product from two ordered edge sets.
(: Intersect
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: return type)))

(: intersection_candidate
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: result type)))

(: intersection_left_name
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: name any)))

(: same_intersection_target
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: name any)))

(: intersection_conflict
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: name any)))

(: has_intersection_conflict
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)))

(: valid_intersection
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)))

(: intersection_edge_candidate
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: side text)
      (: name any)
      (: target any)
      (: source_index int)))

(: intersection_predecessor
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: side text)
      (: source_index int)
      (: prior_side text)
      (: prior_index int)))

(: intersection_has_predecessor
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: side text)
      (: source_index int)))

(: intersection_rank
   (* (: left type)
      (: right type)
      (: side text)
      (: source_index int)
      (: result_index int)))

; Extend is an ordinary userland alias over intersection.
(: Extend
   (* (: base type)
      (: extension type)
      (: return type)))

; Impl evidence is authored data. The witness is checked structurally.
(: implements
   (* (: contract type)
      (: source type)
      (: witness type)))

(: valid_impl
   (* (: contract type)
      (: source type)
      (: witness type)))

(: invalid_impl_edge
   (* (: contract type)
      (: source type)
      (: witness type)
      (: name any)
      (: target any)
      (: contract_index int)))

; Conformance application records its intern request before proof validation.
; A failed proof therefore becomes inspectable in a later compiler round.
(<- (Conforms ?Source ?Contract ?Proof)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Contract ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern Conforms ?Arguments ?Proof)
    (valid_conformance ?Source ?Contract))

(<- (Conforms ?Source ?Contract ?Proof)
    (intern_snapshot Conforms ?Arguments ?Proof)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Contract ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (valid_conformance ?Source ?Contract))

(<- (conformance_candidate ?Source ?Contract ?Proof)
    (intern_snapshot Conforms ?Arguments ?Proof)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Contract ?Empty ?TailArguments))

(<- (matching_contract_edge
       ?Source ?Contract ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex)
    (conformance_candidate ?Source ?Contract ?Proof)
    (edge_snapshot ?Contract ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex)
    (edge_snapshot ?Source ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex))

(<- (missing_contract_edge
       ?Source ?Contract ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex)
    (conformance_candidate ?Source ?Contract ?Proof)
    (edge_snapshot ?Contract ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex)
    (not (matching_contract_edge
           ?Source ?Contract ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex)))

(<- (has_missing_contract_edge ?Source ?Contract)
    (missing_contract_edge
      ?Source ?Contract ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex))

(<- (valid_conformance ?Source ?Contract)
    (conformance_candidate ?Source ?Contract ?Proof)
    (not (has_missing_contract_edge ?Source ?Contract)))

(<- (node ?Proof)
    (Conforms ?Source ?Contract ?Proof))

; Contract-list application and recursive conjunction.
(<- (ConformsAll ?Source ?Contracts ?Proof)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Contracts ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern ConformsAll ?Arguments ?Proof)
    (all_contracts_conform ?Source ?Contracts ?Contracts))

(<- (ConformsAll ?Source ?Contracts ?Proof)
    (intern_snapshot ConformsAll ?Arguments ?Proof)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Contracts ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (all_contracts_conform ?Source ?Contracts ?Contracts))

(<- (conforms_all_candidate ?Source ?Contracts ?Proof)
    (intern_snapshot ConformsAll ?Arguments ?Proof)
    (cons ?Source ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Contracts ?Empty ?TailArguments))

(<- (all_contracts_conform ?Source ?Empty ?Root)
    (conforms_all_candidate ?Source ?Root ?Proof)
    (nil ?Empty))

(<- (all_contracts_conform ?Source ?Current ?Root)
    (conforms_all_candidate ?Source ?Root ?Proof)
    (cons ?Contract ?Tail ?Current)
    (Conforms ?Source ?Contract ?ContractProof)
    (all_contracts_conform ?Source ?Tail ?Root))

(<- (node ?Proof)
    (ConformsAll ?Source ?Contracts ?Proof))

; Intersection application records the candidate identity before validation.
(<- (Intersect ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Right ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (cons ?Left ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern Intersect ?Arguments ?Result)
    (valid_intersection ?Left ?Right))

(<- (Intersect ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Intersect ?Arguments ?Result)
    (cons ?Left ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Right ?Empty ?TailArguments)
    (valid_intersection ?Left ?Right))

(<- (intersection_candidate ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Intersect ?Arguments ?Result)
    (cons ?Left ?TailArguments ?Arguments)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Right ?Empty ?TailArguments))

(<- (intersection_left_name ?Left ?Right ?Name)
    (intersection_candidate ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (edge_snapshot ?Left ?Name ?Target ?Index))

(<- (same_intersection_target ?Left ?Right ?Name)
    (intersection_candidate ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (edge_snapshot ?Left ?Name ?Target ?LeftIndex)
    (edge_snapshot ?Right ?Name ?Target ?RightIndex))

(<- (intersection_conflict ?Left ?Right ?Name)
    (intersection_candidate ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (edge_snapshot ?Left ?Name ?LeftTarget ?LeftIndex)
    (edge_snapshot ?Right ?Name ?RightTarget ?RightIndex)
    (not (same_intersection_target ?Left ?Right ?Name)))

(<- (has_intersection_conflict ?Left ?Right)
    (intersection_conflict ?Left ?Right ?Name))

(<- (valid_intersection ?Left ?Right)
    (intersection_candidate ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (not (has_intersection_conflict ?Left ?Right)))

(<- (intersection_edge_candidate
       ?Left ?Right "left" ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (valid_intersection ?Left ?Right)
    (edge_snapshot ?Left ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex))

(<- (intersection_edge_candidate
       ?Left ?Right "right" ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (valid_intersection ?Left ?Right)
    (edge_snapshot ?Right ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (not (intersection_left_name ?Left ?Right ?Name)))

; Within-side predecessors preserve source order.
(<- (intersection_predecessor
       ?Left ?Right "left" ?SourceIndex "left" ?PriorIndex)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right "left" ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right "left" ?PriorName ?PriorTarget ?PriorIndex)
    (int_lt ?PriorIndex ?SourceIndex))

(<- (intersection_predecessor
       ?Left ?Right "right" ?SourceIndex "right" ?PriorIndex)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right "right" ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right "right" ?PriorName ?PriorTarget ?PriorIndex)
    (int_lt ?PriorIndex ?SourceIndex))

; Every retained left edge precedes every right-only edge.
(<- (intersection_predecessor
       ?Left ?Right "right" ?SourceIndex "left" ?PriorIndex)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right "right" ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right "left" ?PriorName ?PriorTarget ?PriorIndex))

(<- (intersection_has_predecessor
       ?Left ?Right ?Side ?SourceIndex)
    (intersection_predecessor
      ?Left ?Right ?Side ?SourceIndex ?PriorSide ?PriorIndex))

(<- (intersection_rank
       ?Left ?Right ?Side ?SourceIndex (count ?PriorIndex))
    (intersection_predecessor
      ?Left ?Right ?Side ?SourceIndex ?PriorSide ?PriorIndex))

(<- (intersection_rank ?Left ?Right ?Side ?SourceIndex 0)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right ?Side ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (not (intersection_has_predecessor
           ?Left ?Right ?Side ?SourceIndex)))

(<- (: ?Result ?Name ?Target ?ResultIndex)
    (Intersect ?Left ?Right ?Result)
    (intersection_edge_candidate
      ?Left ?Right ?Side ?Name ?Target ?SourceIndex)
    (intersection_rank
      ?Left ?Right ?Side ?SourceIndex ?ResultIndex))

(<- (node ?Result)
    (Intersect ?Left ?Right ?Result))

(<- (product ?Result)
    (Intersect ?Left ?Right ?Result))

(<- (Extend ?Base ?Extension ?Result)
    (Intersect ?Base ?Extension ?Result))

; Impl validation reuses conformance and retains failed contract edges.
(<- (valid_impl ?Contract ?Source ?Witness)
    (implements ?Contract ?Source ?Witness)
    (Conforms ?Witness ?Contract ?Proof))

(<- (invalid_impl_edge
       ?Contract ?Source ?Witness ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex)
    (implements ?Contract ?Source ?Witness)
    (missing_contract_edge
      ?Witness ?Contract ?Name ?Target ?ContractIndex))
